profiles.name: Tiong King Sing
profiles.position: Minister of Tourism, Arts and Culture
profiles.description: Tiong King Sing is Minister of Tourism, Arts and Culture. He represents Bintulu, Sarawak, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of the Progressive Democratic Party (PDP).

profiles.name: Fahmi Fadzil
profiles.description: Fahmi Fadzil is Minister of Communications. He represents Lembah Pantai, Kuala Lumpur, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of Parti Keadilan Rakyat (PKR).

milestones.title: Attract 47 million visitors during Visit Malaysia 2026
milestones.description: MOTAC’s account of Tiong’s Mesra Malaysia campaign launch states a target of 47 million visitors for Visit Malaysia 2026.
milestones.progress_note: The campaign launch is confirmed, but the comparable full-year visitor result was not established. Visitors and overnight tourists are different measures; no tourist-arrivals figure is substituted. Target outcome and completion percentage remain unknown.

milestones.title: Extend Internet coverage to all populated areas
milestones.description: Fahmi said JENDELA would use satellite and small-cell solutions to reach 100% Internet coverage in populated areas, including remote settlements.
milestones.progress_note: The 27 October report gives a 99% coverage baseline and describes the planned technology changes. Coverage is a sector metric, not a completion score. This is an ongoing expansion; the source supplies no firm overall deadline.

party_parents_added.name: Progressive Democratic Party
party_parents_added.description: A component party of Gabungan Parti Sarawak (GPS).

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.
